messages:
ana: quick verification run request for the launch assets + webinar next week. need final headline validation: p95/p99 token latency, coldstart heatmap, long-context tail probe, and delta vs float16 for quantized-n4. short turnaround.

sam: copy. what region, payloads, traffic, and exact artifacts do you need?

ana: region: us-west-2. payloads: (1) 30-word elevator pitch, (2) 1600-token product+policy excerpt + "summarize obligations in 120 words", (3) a long-context coherence probe ~2500 tokens that references earlier context and asks for a plan. traffic: smoke profile — 55 qps sustained measurement window. duration: 9m measurement after warmup. induce 3 coldstarts. artifacts: latencies.csv (per-request), heatmap.png, samples.json (10 examples per prompt), manifest.txt with model hash, seeds, run CLI. exclude KV cache dumps.

leo: do you want warmup sensitivity buckets or a single warmup?

ana: please provide two buckets in the artifact: warmup=90s and warmup=240s. label them separately in the CSV. that way marketing can pick conservative numbers.

maria: also include RNG seeds + dataset id and a 1-line methodology blurb I can paste into the blog. tag S3 path.

sam: plan: staging cluster run, seeds 3,42,107. warmup buckets 90s & 240s; measurement 9m each. will record token-level latencies and GPU utilization traces (lightweight). s3 prefix: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1812345670-headline-verif/. will add CLI snippet in manifest for reproducibility.

ana: perfect. please also include exact model revision and commit hash. marketing will annotate the post with the verbatim manifest.

benchbot: Scheduled bench job rb-1812345670 on staging for 2024-07-22T01:00:00Z. ETA artifacts: ~40m after run. (config attached)

sam: running now. will run quantized-n4 and float16 baseline back-to-back to avoid infra drift.

benchbot: rb-1812345670 RUNNING: quantized-n4 (warmup 90s) -> meas 9m -> quantized-n4 (warmup 240s) -> meas 9m -> float16 baseline replicates.

leo: induced coldstarts at minutes 3, 6, and 8 of each measurement window by restarting workers.

benchbot: rb-1812345670 COMPLETE. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1812345670-headline-verif/{manifest.txt,latencies.csv,heatmap.png,samples.json,gpu-util.csv}.

benchbot: Summary (measurement windows):
- quantized-n4 (90s warmup): p95=82ms p99=265ms; coldstart first-token spike median ~0.95s.
- quantized-n4 (240s warmup): p95=74ms p99=190ms; coldstart first-token spike median ~0.6s.
- float16 baseline (240s warmup): p95=68ms p99=160ms.

maria: grabbing artifacts. note for the blog: warmup bucket matters — quantized-n4 p99 drops substantially with longer warmup. will draft the one-paragraph methodology and a CSV header line for slides. :eyes: 

sam: quick diff vs last internal run: quantized-n4 p99 (240s warmup) is +7% vs last week; 90s warmup p99 is +30% vs last week (warmup sensitivity spike). investigating possible staging warmup ordering change.

ana: flag anything >20% as a regression we should call out to eng. sam, if you think the staging warmup ordering caused the short-warmup spike and a 240s rerun would normalize it, note that in the manifest. marketing will prefer the conservative 240s numbers but wants the 90s bucket to illustrate warmup sensitivity.

sam: will annotate manifest: sequencing note and exact CLI used. adding reproducible snippet below for docs: 
```
bench-run --model redwood/quantized-n4:rev-20240722-abc123 --region us-west-2 --qps 55 --warmup 90 --duration 540 --seeds 3,42,107 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1812345670-headline-verif/90s/
bench-run --model redwood/quantized-n4:rev-20240722-abc123 --region us-west-2 --qps 55 --warmup 240 --duration 540 --seeds 3,42,107 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1812345670-headline-verif/240s/
bench-run --model redwood/float16:rev-20240722-def456 --region us-west-2 --qps 55 --warmup 240 --duration 540 --seeds 3,42,107 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1812345670-headline-verif/float16/
```

maria: perfect. I'll add the methodology blurb: "Runs executed on staging (us-west-2) with seeds [3,42,107]. Two warmup regimes (90s and 240s) were measured to show warmup sensitivity. Per-request latencies recorded at token granularity; artifacts include latencies.csv, heatmap.png, samples.json, and run manifest with model revision hash."

ana: great. final ask: highlight any p99 increases >20% in the release notes. if eng wants to propose a re-run for public numbers we can schedule, otherwise we'll publish with the 240s conservative bucket and a note about sensitivity. Thanks team! :tada:
